name: B10-0042/2024 (PfE) – The case of José Daniel Ferrier García in Cuba
title: Resolution on the case of José Daniel Ferrer García in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of José Daniel Ferrer García, a Cuban human rights activist it says is jailed in dangerous conditions. It asks Cuba to free him and all other people held for their political views, and to give him medical care. It also condemns Cuba's treatment of protesters and dissidents, and asks the European Union to sanction those responsible, stop financial aid to Cuba, and suspend its cooperation agreement with Cuba.

- It asks the EU to suspend its cooperation agreement with Cuba and stop all financial aid.
- It calls on Cuba to free Ferrer and other political prisoners and give him medical care.
- It urges EU governments to sanction Cuban officials blamed for human rights violations.
